gaps.title: No caching for pip dependencies
gaps.description: CI installs dependencies from scratch every run. pip cache and setup-python cache should be enabled.
gaps.impact: Slower CI runs (~30s extra per job)

gaps.title: No concurrency group for CI
gaps.description: Multiple pushes trigger redundant CI runs. Should cancel in-progress runs on same branch.
gaps.impact: Wasted CI minutes on rapid pushes
gaps.recommended_fix: Add concurrency: group: ci-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress: true

gaps.title: No Python 3.13 in test matrix
gaps.description: Test matrix covers 3.10-3.12 but not 3.13. Should add forward-compat testing.

gaps.title: No coverage reporting
gaps.description: Tests run but no coverage report is generated or uploaded.
gaps.impact: No visibility into test coverage trends
gaps.recommended_fix: Add pytest-cov and upload to codecov

gaps.title: No multi-stage build
gaps.description: Single-stage build includes build tools in final image. Multi-stage reduces image size.
gaps.recommended_fix: Use multi-stage: builder stage + runtime stage

gaps.title: No .dockerignore for gaps/
gaps.description: gaps/ directory with JSON reports is copied into Docker image.

gaps.title: Hardcoded credentials in compose
gaps.description: POSTGRES_PASSWORD=agtech is hardcoded. Should use .env file.
gaps.impact: Security risk if repo is public

gaps.title: No GPU service in compose
gaps.description: GPU solvers (gpu_tsp, gpu_vrp) need NVIDIA runtime but compose doesn't configure it.
gaps.recommended_fix: Add runtime: nvidia to app service

gaps.title: torch is a heavy dependency
gaps.description: torch==2.5.1 is ~800MB. Most modules don't need it. Should be optional.

gaps.title: No version upper bounds on rdflib
gaps.description: rdflib>=7.0,<8 is fine but other deps use ==. Inconsistent.

gaps.title: No docker-test target
gaps.description: Can't run tests inside Docker container.
gaps.recommended_fix: Add docker-test: docker compose run app pytest

gaps.title: No scheduled CI runs
gaps.description: No cron schedule to catch dependency breakage.
